sentences.en: Because of its unlikely host, the tiny, energy-rich country of Qatar.
sentences.zh: 因为主办国是一个不太可能的选择：那个国土狭小、能源丰富的卡塔尔。

sentences.en: They're hosting an event expected to attract over a million spectators in person to a country just the size of Connecticut.

sentences.en: Today, I talked to my colleague Tarek Panja about how Qatar got the cup and at what coSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与同事塔里克·潘贾谈论了卡塔尔是如何获得世界杯主办权的，以及付出了什么代价。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月28日，星期一。

sentences.en: So, Tarek, you cover soccer and the business of sports for The Times.
sentences.zh: 那么，塔里克，你为《纽约时报》报道足球和体育商业新闻。

sentences.en: And you've been writing about the World Cup in Qatar since it was selected to hoSt.
sentences.zh: 自从卡塔尔被选为东道主以来，你一直在撰写关于卡塔尔世界杯的报道。

sentences.en: And now you're finally there.
sentences.zh: 现在你终于身临其境了。

sentences.en: So, what's it been like?
sentences.zh: 感觉如何？

sentences.en: It's been a surreal journey.
sentences.zh: 这是一段超现实的旅程。

sentences.en: Welcome to Doha, the state of Qatar.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到卡塔尔国多哈。

sentences.en: Your gateway to the world.

sentences.en: This country has, you know, in many ways been rebuilt around a one-month-long sporting event.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个国家在很多方面都是围绕着一个为期一个月的体育赛事而重建的。

sentences.en: Welcome to Qatar, 2022.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到2022年卡塔尔。

sentences.en: And you get that sense everywhere you go.
sentences.zh: 无论走到哪里，你都能感受到这一点。

sentences.zh: 从你抵达哈马德国际机场的那一刻起，穿过航站楼，一切都显得非常光鲜、崭新。

sentences.zh: 这个地铁系统在很大程度上是为了将足球迷运送到这个小国的世界杯体育场而建造的。

sentences.en: We've just arrived in the apartment where we're going to be spending the next month.
sentences.zh: 我们刚到我们要住一个月的公寓。

sentences.en: Me and my colleagues from The New York Times here, we're staying in an apartment block and we are the first guests.
sentences.zh: 我和《纽约时报》的同事们住在一个公寓楼里，我们是第一批住客。

sentences.en: Everything is new.

sentences.zh: 为了举办世界杯，他们基本上是从零开始建造了一切。

sentences.zh: 现在终于开始了，实际情况如何？

sentences.zh: 是的，到目前为止并不算一帆风顺。

sentences.zh: 卡塔尔，这一路走来有些颠簸。

sentences.zh: 最大的冲突点之一是关于啤酒的问题。

sentences.en: Beer.

sentences.zh: 卡塔尔曾向世界承诺，就像其他每一届世界杯一样，这里会有啤酒供应。

sentences.en: It's a conservative Muslim country.
sentences.zh: 这是一个保守的穆斯林国家。

sentences.en: And that didn't go down too well with the domestic population, as you would expect.
sentences.zh: 正如你所料，这在当地民众中并不受欢迎。

sentences.en: It's not part of their culture.
sentences.zh: 这不是他们文化的一部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's been this push and pull.
sentences.zh: 一直存在这种拉锯战。

sentences.en: But 100 days before the World Cup, FIFA and the local organizers announced there would be beer within the perimeter of the stadium.
sentences.zh: 但在世界杯开赛前100天，国际足联和当地组委会宣布，体育场周边区域内将供应啤酒。

sentences.en: And then, suddenly, we start to see this shift.
sentences.zh: 然后，突然之间，我们开始看到这种转变。

sentences.zh: 锦标赛前一周，埃米尔的兄弟出来视察。

sentences.zh: 他不喜欢那些红色百威帐篷的样子，要求把它们移走。

sentences.en: The royal family does not want it here.

sentences.en: And Qatar, this thumb-shaped peninsula located next to the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, decides it needs to do something to be known in the world, to have its place.
sentences.zh: 而卡塔尔，这个位于阿拉伯联合酋长国和沙特阿拉伯旁边的拇指状半岛，决定需要做点什么来让世界认识它，确立自己的地位。

sentences.en: Yes, it's wealthy, but it needs something to give it some great standing.
sentences.zh: 是的，它很富有，但它需要一些东西来提升自己的国际地位。

sentences.en: Why not bid for the world's most popular sporting event?
sentences.zh: 为什么不申办世界上最受欢迎的体育赛事呢？

sentences.en: And it was just not taken seriously in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 起初，这并没有被当真。

sentences.en: If you ask, you know, if Qatar has the possibility of hosting the World Cup, everybody will say, you are crazy, you are crazy.
sentences.zh: 如果你问卡塔尔是否有能力举办世界杯，每个人都会说，你疯了，你疯了。

sentences.en: There was nothing about this bid that would have made sense.

sentences.en: Apart from one thing, I think.

sentences.en: What will it mean to the region if the world's greatest sporting event comes to the Middle East for the very first time?

sentences.en: You will be proud of us.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如你所指出的，他们完全没有能力举办。

sentences.en: So why try for it to begin with?
sentences.zh: 那为什么要从一开始就尝试呢？

sentences.zh: 当我们审视这个问题时，有两个故事。

sentences.en: One is the one that is described by the Qatari officials when you ask them.
sentences.zh: 一个是当你询问卡塔尔官员时，他们所描述的版本。

sentences.zh: 他们说，我们有一个建设卡塔尔的国家项目。

sentences.en: And even if we didn't get the World Cup, we would be building all of these things.
sentences.zh: 即使我们没有获得世界杯，我们也会建造所有这些设施。

sentences.zh: 你知道，我们需要一个拥有世界其他地方所具备的基础设施的现代化国家。

sentences.en: And this kind of accelerates that.
sentences.zh: 而这加速了进程。

sentences.en: But if you ask other people, this is a tiny country in a tough neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 但如果你问其他人，这是一个处于艰难地缘环境中的小国。

sentences.en: Just being in the region, there is that rivalry between these different kingdoMs.
sentences.zh: 仅仅身处该地区，这些不同的王国之间就存在竞争。

sentences.en: They're all fabulously wealthy.
sentences.zh: 他们都极其富有。

sentences.en: There's only so many palaces you can build.
sentences.zh: 你能建造的宫殿数量有限。

sentences.en: There's so many luxury hotels.
sentences.zh: 豪华酒店的数量也有限。

sentences.en: But there's only one World Cup.
sentences.zh: 但世界杯只有一个。

sentences.en: And now the emirs of Qatar have had it.

sentences.en: They've got the firSt.

sentences.en: It's not Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 不是沙特阿拉伯。

sentences.en: It's not the UAE.
sentences.zh: 不是阿联酋。

sentences.en: It's not Bahrain.
sentences.zh: 不是巴林。

sentences.en: It is here.
sentences.zh: 它就在这里。

sentences.en: And no one can take that away from them.
sentences.zh: 没有人能从他们手中夺走。

sentences.en: So it's like a prestige thing, basically.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上是一种虚荣心作祟。

sentences.en: Kind of a marketing project in their competition with other Gulf states.
sentences.zh: 在与其他海湾国家的竞争中，这算是一种营销项目。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we've seen sport as a vehicle for this in the region.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到体育在该地区成为了实现这一目标的工具。

sentences.en: So next door, you have the UAE.

sentences.en: This is a team that has absolutely crushed all its opponents.
sentences.zh: 这是一个彻底击败了所有对手的团队。

sentences.en: So sport has always been used as this vehicle.
sentences.zh: 所以体育运动一直被用作这种工具。

sentences.en: And there's been this competition to exert this soft power through sport.
sentences.zh: 而且一直存在着通过体育运动来施加这种软实力的竞争。

sentences.en: And Qatar, for me, have put the accelerator down on this.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，卡塔尔在这方面踩下了油门。

sentences.en: They have got the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 他们拿下了世界杯。

sentences.en: Nothing bigger.
sentences.zh: 没有比这更重大的事了。

sentences.en: Okay, so Tarek, I get why they want to host the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 好吧，塔雷克，我明白他们为什么要申办世界杯。

sentences.en: But as you told us before, you know, they don't have any of the infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 但正如你之前告诉我们的，他们没有任何基础设施。

sentences.en: So my question to you is, how did they actually get it?
sentences.zh: 所以我问你，他们到底是怎么得到的？

sentences.zh: 比如，他们是怎么赢得竞标的？

sentences.zh: 公开来说，他们投入的资金比其他任何竞标国家都多，用于制作演示文稿、赞助活动，以打响知名度。

sentences.zh: 他们邀请了国际足联执行委员会中将在选举中投票的22人多次访问卡塔尔。

sentences.en: They showed them air-conditioned stadiums they would build.
sentences.zh: 他们向这些人展示了他们将要建造的空调体育场。

sentences.en: They hired former football players that were world-famous.
sentences.zh: 他们聘请了世界知名的前足球运动员。

sentences.en: For example, Zinedine Zidane, the French World Cup hero from 98.
sentences.zh: 例如，98年法国世界杯英雄齐内丁·齐达内。

sentences.en: They paid him millions just to endorse their bid.
sentences.zh: 他们付给他数百万美元，仅仅是为了让他为他们的申办代言。

sentences.en: They threw the kitchen sink at it in terms of wealth to get their name out there.
sentences.zh: 为了打响知名度，他们在财富方面可谓倾其所有。

sentences.en: But behind the scenes, they were also lobbying intensely this group of 22 men to convince them.
sentences.zh: 但在幕后，他们也在对这22人进行激烈的游说，以说服他们。

sentences.en: And none of that is played out in demonstrations or in adverts or anything like this.
sentences.zh: 而这些都没有在示威、广告或任何类似的事情中表现出来。

sentences.en: This is smoke-filled rooms and meals and private conversations.
sentences.zh: 这是烟雾缭绕的房间、宴请和私下交谈。

sentences.en: What can we do for you?
sentences.zh: 我们能为你做些什么？

sentences.en: So basically, you're saying that they got it the old-fashioned way, right?
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，你是说他们是用老派的方式得到的，对吧？

sentences.en: Corruption.
sentences.zh: 腐败。

sentences.en: Buying off these FIFA guys.
sentences.zh: 收买这些国际足联的人。

sentences.en: Well, immediately, that's where everyone's minds turned.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大家立刻就想到了这一点。

sentences.en: Shortly after the World Cup was awarded here, allegations of corruption surfaced, that FIFA officials had taken bribes to vote in favor of Qatar's bid.
sentences.zh: 在世界杯主办权授予这里后不久，腐败指控就浮出水面，称国际足联官员收受贿赂，投票支持卡塔尔的申办。

sentences.en: This process was already in doubt.
sentences.zh: 这个过程本身就已受到质疑。

sentences.en: Two members were suspended over allegations they'd offered to sell their votes.
sentences.zh: 两名成员因涉嫌出卖选票而被停职。

sentences.en: Two of the voting members had been expelled for offering to sell their votes to undercover reporters.
sentences.zh: 两名投票成员因向卧底记者兜售选票而被开除。

sentences.en: This was a highly biddable, buyable group of individuals.
sentences.zh: 这是一群非常容易被收买的人。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: A whistleblower has alleged three members were offered cash for votes by Qatar.
sentences.zh: 一名举报人声称，卡塔尔曾向三名成员提供现金以换取选票。

sentences.en: Everyone was trying to find this smoking gun.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在试图找到这个确凿的证据。

sentences.en: They were expected to uphold the rules that keep soccer honest and to protect the integrity of the game.
sentences.zh: 他们本应维护足球诚实的规则，保护比赛的公正性。

sentences.en: Hearing the former head of UEFA, Michel Platini, has been detained by French police investigating the award of the 2022 World Cup to Qatar.
sentences.zh: 听说前欧足联主席米歇尔·普拉蒂尼已被法国警方拘留，调查授予卡塔尔2022年世界杯主办权一事。

sentences.en: Reports after reports of potential bribes of these men were broadcast in European media.
sentences.zh: 欧洲媒体播出了关于这些人可能受贿的一篇又一篇报道。

sentences.en: This really is the World Cup of fraud.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一场欺诈的世界杯。

sentences.en: But Qatar steadfastly denied all of this for all these years.
sentences.zh: 但多年来，卡塔尔一直坚定地否认这一切。

sentences.en: When people say, how did you win the World Cup?
sentences.zh: 当人们问，你们是怎么赢得世界杯的？

sentences.en: You know, the simplest answer, and I assure you and I promise you, it is not said in any way with any arrogance.
sentences.zh: 你知道，最简单的回答，我向你保证，我向你承诺，这绝没有任何傲慢的意思。

sentences.en: We were the best bid.
sentences.zh: 我们的申办方案是最好的。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Prosecutors have revealed new details of alleged bribes paid to FIFA executive committee members to gain their votes for Qatar to host the 2022 World Cup.
sentences.zh: 检察官披露了有关向国际足联执行委员会成员支付贿赂以换取他们投票支持卡塔尔举办2022年世界杯的新细节。

sentences.en: There was a curious detail in a US indictment related to soccer corruption.
sentences.zh: 在美国一份与足球腐败有关的起诉书中，有一个耐人寻味的细节。

sentences.en: Then-president of the South American governing body, Conmebol, and former Brazil Federation president, Ricardo Teixeira, received bribes to vote for Qatar at the...
sentences.zh: 南美足联时任主席、前巴西足协主席里卡多·特谢拉收受贿赂，投票支持卡塔尔……

sentences.en: It said three of the South American voting members, received money to select Qatar.
sentences.zh: 书中称，三名南美投票成员收受了钱财，选择了卡塔尔。

sentences.en: That's the closest we've had of any major authority confirming our worst suspicions, that bribes were paid and Qatar was the victor.
sentences.zh: 这是我们所能得到的最接近主要权威机构证实我们最坏怀疑的消息，即贿赂确实存在，而卡塔尔是获胜者。

sentences.en: What we can be sure of is that most of the committee that took this decision have since been accused, banned, or indicted over allegations of corruption or wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 我们可以确定的是，做出这一决定的大多数委员会成员此后都因腐败或不当行为的指控而受到指责、禁赛或起诉。

sentences.en: Okay, so at this point, it seems like Qatar bribed their way to host this World Cup.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在这一点上，看起来卡塔尔是通过贿赂获得了世界杯的主办权。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, they got it, right?
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，他们还是拿到了，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, it's there.
sentences.zh: 就像，它就在那里。

sentences.en: So then what do they actually have to do to make it happen?
sentences.zh: 那么他们实际上必须做些什么才能实现这一目标呢？

sentences.en: Well, they embarked on an intense building frenzy, the life of which few would have seen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们开始了一场疯狂的建设狂潮，这种规模很少有人见过。

sentences.en: This is a 12-year process of reimagining an entire country.
sentences.zh: 这是一个长达12年的重塑整个国家的过程。

sentences.en: Yes, it's small, but it is a rebuild of a nation.
sentences.zh: 是的，它很小，但这是一个国家的重建。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Okay, so Tarek, how does Qatar approach trying to pull off this pretty crazy feat?
sentences.zh: 好吧，塔雷克，卡塔尔是如何着手完成这一疯狂壮举的？

sentences.en: Well, I think after they took a big gulp that, oh, we're now going to have to do this, they have to figure out how they're going to build an entire country.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想在他们深吸一口气意识到“哦，我们现在必须做这件事”之后，他们必须弄清楚如何建造一个完整的国家。

sentences.en: This is building seven stadiums in the desert.
sentences.zh: 这需要在沙漠中建造七个体育场。

sentences.en: This is building hundreds of miles of road.
sentences.zh: 这需要修建数百英里的道路。

sentences.en: This is building sewage systems, scores of hotels, a new metro system, a port, like anything you can think of, this country needed to build.
sentences.zh: 这需要建造污水处理系统、几十家酒店、一个新的地铁系统、一个港口，就像你能想到的任何东西，这个国家都需要建造。

sentences.en: And how are they going to do it?
sentences.zh: 他们打算怎么做呢？

sentences.en: When you have a domestic population as small as this, the World Cup final stadium in Luzail is 80,000.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有像这样小的国内人口时，卢塞尔的世界杯决赛体育场可容纳8万人。

sentences.en: If you fill that four times, that's pretty much all of the Qatari nationals in the world.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它填满四次，那基本上就是世界上所有的卡塔尔国民了。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Every citizen.
sentences.zh: 每一位公民。

sentences.en: Every citizen.
sentences.zh: 每一位公民。

sentences.en: And around this region, there are some poor people just across the water who are desperate for work.
sentences.zh: 在这个地区周围，水域对面有一些穷人，他们迫切需要工作。

sentences.en: These are people who are living hand to mouth with few job opportunities where they are, particularly in South Asia, parts of West Africa as well, Philippines.
sentences.zh: 这些人生活在温饱线上，在他们所在的地方几乎没有就业机会，特别是在南亚、西非部分地区，还有菲律宾。

sentences.en: So you have this wealthy country with huge ambition meeting desperate poverty.
sentences.zh: 所以你有一个拥有巨大野心的富裕国家，遇到了绝望的贫困。

sentences.en: And hundreds of thousands of workers from these countries are dragged to Qatar through force of need.
sentences.zh: 成千上万来自这些国家的工人因生存需求被拉到了卡塔尔。

sentences.en: Now, Qatar's population spiked not far from doubling from the moment they started bidding in 2009 to this period in 2022.
sentences.zh: 现在，从2009年他们开始申办到2022年这段时间，卡塔尔的人口激增，几乎翻了一番。

sentences.en: This population increase is solely down to the need for workers to build this country.
sentences.zh: 人口的增加完全是因为需要工人来建设这个国家。

sentences.en: All told, about 85 to 90 percent of this country is made up of migrant workers.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，这个国家大约85%到90%的人口是外籍劳工。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And, you know, you're talking about people earning less than $10 a day in one of the wealthiest countries in the planet.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你谈论的是在地球上最富有的国家之一，每天收入不到10美元的人。

sentences.en: They get up in the morning, extremely early, often before dawn.
sentences.zh: 他们早上起得很早，通常在黎明前。

sentences.en: They'll get on buses and they get driven to labor sites.
sentences.zh: 他们会坐上巴士，被送到劳动工地。

sentences.en: They will do eight to 10 hours at these places doing the most difficult work in the most difficult conditions.
sentences.zh: 他们会在这些地方工作8到10个小时，在最困难的条件下做最艰苦的工作。

sentences.en: Don't forget, in the summer, the temperature rises to up to 50 degrees.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，夏天温度会升至50度。

sentences.en: So over 100 Fahrenheit.
sentences.zh: 也就是超过100华氏度。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then they will do that for six days a week.
sentences.zh: 然后他们每周要工作六天。

sentences.en: And they are the army that is going to build this country.
sentences.zh: 他们就是将要建设这个国家的军队。

sentences.en: And that is what they did for this entire period.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们在整个期间所做的事情。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So just to recap here, Qatar needs to build all these stadiums, all this infrastructure, roads, even hotels and office buildings in order to successfully host the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 那么总结一下，卡塔尔需要建造所有这些体育场、所有这些基础设施、道路，甚至酒店和办公楼，才能成功举办世界杯。

sentences.en: And they don't have the people.
sentences.zh: 而且他们没有足够的人手。

sentences.en: So they bring in migrants like many other countries in the world, right?
sentences.zh: 所以他们像世界上许多其他国家一样引进了移民，对吧？

sentences.en: The United States has done this too.
sentences.zh: 美国也这样做过。

sentences.en: You know, many countries do this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，许多国家都这样做。

sentences.en: But it's particularly common and particularly harsh often in the Gulf.
sentences.zh: 但在海湾地区，这尤其普遍，而且往往特别严酷。

sentences.en: So what do we know at this point about how this ultimately went?
sentences.zh: 那么关于这一切最终是如何发展的，我们现在知道些什么？

sentences.en: I mean, what happened to these migrants?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些移民发生了什么？

sentences.en: We've seen stories of awful accommodation.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了关于恶劣住宿条件的故事。

sentences.en: Men crammed together in tiny living spaces, sometimes with no air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 男人们挤在狭小的生活空间里，有时甚至没有空调。

sentences.en: There was too much heat.
sentences.zh: 天气太热了。

sentences.en: My shoes used to be filled with sweat.
sentences.zh: 我的鞋子里总是汗水。

sentences.en: There was no electricity, no food.
sentences.zh: 没有电，没有食物。

sentences.en: We had nothing.
sentences.zh: 我们什么都没有。

sentences.en: We've seen people working in the desert under the hot sun, suffering seizures, dizzy spells.
sentences.zh: 我们看到人们在沙漠里烈日下工作，出现癫痫、头晕。

sentences.en: We've heard of stories of young men of working age found dead in their beds, apparently dying in the night.
sentences.zh: 我们听说过年轻的劳动年龄男性被发现死在床上，显然是在夜间死亡的故事。

sentences.en: One of the most common causes seems to have been respiratory failure and cardiac arreSt.
sentences.zh: 最常见的原因似乎是呼吸衰竭和心脏骤停。

sentences.en: Football's governing body FIFA and the Qatari government introduced worksite inspections to improve conditions.
sentences.zh: 足球管理机构国际足联和卡塔尔政府引入了工地检查以改善条件。

sentences.en: Qatar eventually introduced this rule where in the summer months between a few of the hottest hours in the afternoon, work must stop.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔最终出台了一项规定，即在夏季下午最热的几个小时内，必须停止工作。

sentences.en: But that came belatedly.
sentences.zh: 但这来得太晚了。

sentences.en: When he left for Qatar six months ago, she was his wife.
sentences.zh: 当他六个月前离开去卡塔尔时，她是他的妻子。

sentences.en: Today, she's his widow.
sentences.zh: 今天，她成了他的遗孀。

sentences.en: What we know is thousands of workers who have been in Qatar have died.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，成千上万在卡塔尔的工人已经死亡。

sentences.en: The Guardian also reporting that last year, the Nepalese migrants in Qatar, they were dying at a rate of one every two days.
sentences.zh: 《卫报》还报道称，去年在卡塔尔的尼泊尔移民，死亡率是每两天一人。

sentences.en: A report in the Guardian said 6,500 workers have died in Qatar since 2010.
sentences.zh: 《卫报》的一篇报道称，自2010年以来，已有6500名工人在卡塔尔死亡。

sentences.en: So, according to some reports, thousands of people died building this World Cup.
sentences.zh: 所以，据一些报道，成千上万的人死于建设这届世界杯。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a devastating toll.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个毁灭性的代价。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's not only this.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅如此。

sentences.en: It is also the contractual ties these people have.
sentences.zh: 这还涉及这些人所受的合同约束。

sentences.en: They are, across the Gulf, at least when this Qatar project started, part of something which is called the kafala system,
sentences.zh: 在整个海湾地区，至少在卡塔尔这个项目开始时，他们是所谓的“卡法拉”制度的一部分，

sentences.en: which ties a migrant worker to one employer, and they would be at the whim of this employer.
sentences.zh: 该制度将外籍劳工与一名雇主绑定，他们将任由雇主摆布。

sentences.en: So they often didn't get paid what they should get paid.
sentences.zh: 所以他们往往拿不到应得的工资。

sentences.en: They had nobody to complain to.
sentences.zh: 他们没有人可以投诉。

sentences.en: And they couldn't even leave the country if they wanted to.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想离开这个国家，甚至都做不到。

sentences.en: They would have had to have been given permission to leave Qatar.
sentences.zh: 他们必须获得许可才能离开卡塔尔。

sentences.en: Tarek, how has the rest of the world responded to these conditions?
sentences.zh: 塔雷克，世界其他地区对这些情况有何反应？

sentences.en: I mean, what are people saying?
sentences.zh: 我是说，人们在说什么？

sentences.en: A World Cup based on labour exploitation.
sentences.zh: 一场建立在劳动剥削基础上的世界杯。

sentences.en: In a new report today, Amnesty says some abuses amount to forced labour.
sentences.zh: 大赦国际在今天的一份新报告中表示，一些虐待行为等同于强迫劳动。

sentences.en: We've seen human rights groups focus very, very closely on this in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，我们看到人权组织非常、非常密切地关注这一点。

sentences.en: Amnesty International has told the BBC that football associations need to start looking into the conditions for migrant workers now.
sentences.zh: 大赦国际告诉英国广播公司，足球协会现在需要开始调查外籍劳工的条件。

sentences.en: And that level of scrutiny has brought it to the attention of some of the European nations that compete in the World Cup, for example.
sentences.zh: 这种审查程度引起了参加世界杯的一些欧洲国家的注意，例如。

sentences.en: Ten European football associations, including those of England and Wales, say that human rights are universal and apply everywhere.
sentences.zh: 包括英格兰和威尔士在内的十个欧洲足球协会表示，人权是普世的，适用于任何地方。

sentences.en: They've found themselves under pressure.
sentences.zh: 他们发现自己承受着压力。

sentences.en: Germany, the English, Denmark, countries where the conversation about human rights is at the top of the agenda most of the time.
sentences.zh: 德国、英国、丹麦，这些国家关于人权的讨论在大多数时候都处于议程的首位。

sentences.en: Some question if ethically the World Cup should move forward in a country with such a history of turning a blind eye to abuse.
sentences.zh: 有些人质疑，在一个对虐待视而不见的国家，从道德上讲，世界杯是否应该继续进行。

sentences.en: And it's not only about migrant workers.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是关于外籍劳工的问题。

sentences.en: This is also about Qatar's relationship and laws related to homosexuality.
sentences.zh: 这也关乎卡塔尔与同性恋相关的关系和法律。

sentences.en: Campaigners in the UK say that they don't think anyone from those communities should be travelling to watch the World Cup in Qatar.
sentences.zh: 英国的活动人士表示，他们认为来自这些群体的人不应该去卡塔尔观看世界杯。

sentences.en: Calls to boycott the tournament have gathered momentum.
sentences.zh: 抵制比赛的呼声越来越高。

sentences.en: And if you're talking about this all of the time, how could you as a nation, in good conscience, send your soccer teams to this World Cup?
sentences.zh: 如果你一直谈论这件事，作为一个国家，你怎么能凭良心把你的足球队送到这届世界杯呢？

sentences.en: So it sounds like, Tarek, that not only is Qatar under pressure for its human rights record,
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，塔雷克，卡塔尔不仅因为其人权记录而承受压力，

sentences.en: but the countries going to the World Cup are also under pressure from their own populations.
sentences.zh: 而且参加世界杯的国家也承受着来自本国民众的压力。

sentences.en: Like, their participation could be seen as endorsing Qatar's treatment of migrants or its approach to LGBTQ issues.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们的参与可能被视为认可卡塔尔对待移民的方式或其对LGBTQ问题的处理方法。

sentences.en: So that pressure has been there.
sentences.zh: 所以这种压力一直存在。

sentences.en: But if they did something, made a big stand in Qatar,
sentences.zh: 但如果他们真的做了什么，在卡塔尔采取了强硬立场，

sentences.en: they would upset their hosts and potentially risk being penalised by FIFA for a tournament that they have prepared for for four years.
sentences.zh: 他们会激怒东道主，并可能冒着被国际足联惩罚的风险，而这可是他们准备了四年的比赛。

sentences.en: This is a culmination of a player's career in many ways.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这是球员职业生涯的巅峰。

sentences.en: There's nothing bigger than the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 没有比世界杯更重大的事了。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, you have this domestic audience that needs you to stand up for values that they think are important.
sentences.zh: 所以一方面，你有国内观众需要你坚持他们认为重要的价值观。

sentences.en: On the other hand, this is everything your career has built up to.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，这是你职业生涯所积累的一切。

sentences.en: So what we've had is various efforts to almost make a stand, I'd say.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到的是各种努力，几乎可以说是为了表明立场。

sentences.en: Denmark, for example, the public there and the media there has been particularly opposed to this World Cup.
